headlines.text: Nvidia posts fiscal Q3 revenue of $115.8B (up 103% YoY, crushing the ~$109B estimate) with EPS of $2.70, guides Q4 to $130B, and unveils a new $150B buyback in interim CEO Colette Kress's first earnings call since Jensen Huang's exit; shares rose about 2% after hours
Nvidia's Q4 guidance assumes zero China data-center compute revenue as export curbs persist, even as Data Center sales hit $107.6B this quarter, up 110% year over year
Dow tumbled nearly 850 points and the Nasdaq booked a third-plus straight losing session Tuesday as stocks sold off heading into Nvidia's earnings
U.S. retail sales growth slowed to 0.2% in October from September's 0.8%, though core sales excluding autos, gas and building materials rose a stronger-than-expected 0.6%
Anthropic set to price its IPO Wednesday at $70-$78 a share, valuing the AI firm near $1.4 trillion ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT

Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting minutes, due out Wednesday, expected to detail the 10-2 vote to hold rates at 3.75%-4%, with Cook and Hammack's dissents favoring a hike underscoring little room for a December cut
